sources.snippet: MiniCPM-o 4.5 is the most advanced model in the MiniCPM-o series, designed to rival proprietary systems like Gemini 2.5 Flash. Built on an end-to-end architecture combining SigLip2, Whisper-medium, CosyVoice2, and a Qwen3-8B backbone, it features 9 billion parameters and excels in real-time multimodal communication.
